integrity_notes: Exact proof by convex separation, supporting-line constraints, diameter disk, and a strictly monotone one-variable sign test; code verifies algebra and numerical approximations but is not a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Two convex equal-area pieces of one Euclidean square only; no claims about arbitrary piece counts, nonconvex pieces, or other shapes. The 2026 motivating manuscript was accessible only through its abstract, leaving a specific source-coverage risk.
title: The unique oblique equal-area bisection maximizing square-piece roundness
